# DynamicControlsPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on this page that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `DynamicControlsElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in

## "Remove/add" form (in the page)

- **(no words: an icon)**: checkbox. In `DynamicControlsElements` as `CHECKBOX`: `check().checkbox()`.
- **"Remove"**: button. In `DynamicControlsElements` as `REMOVE_BUTTON`: `click().remove()`.

## "Enable/disable" form (in the page)

- **(no words: an icon)**: text field. In `DynamicControlsElements` as `TEXT_FIELD_INPUT`: `enter().textField(...)`.
- **"Enable"**: button. In `DynamicControlsElements` as `ENABLE_BUTTON`: `click().enable()`.
